limitations: No answer quality, citation correctness, or rubric criterion judgment was performed. No blind review files were accessed.
Final answers were compared programmatically for presence, equality and hashes; their quality was not inspected.
One admitted r03-zg MCP call failed for root=/; this is an observed agent/tool outcome under the unchanged protocol, not an infrastructure failure or budget denial. It is retained without rerun.
Source unchanged after each trial is controller evidence; source export and runtime manifest contents were independently recomputed, but the destroyed runner filesystem cannot be re-inspected.

Container runtime config files, model cache and binary bytes are intentionally absent from the published artifact. Their identity is supported by frozen runner code, recorded commands, provenance, startup events and offline preflight; binary bytes were not independently rehashed here.

The 8192 output setting is per request. Final usage output_tokens is cumulative across the session; modelUsage.maxOutputTokens=32000 is model metadata, not an archived live request-body field establishing the effective cap. Live provider request bodies were not archived.
Secret scans check known injected credential values; their passing status is verified, but the auditor did not possess credentials to repeat those exact scans.
Hook elapsed times and controller wall times are recorded evidence, not an independent external wall-clock monitor.
GitHub run metadata lag is retained explicitly; no replacement, rerun or additional model inference was performed.
Token ratios are per frozen pair. No quality conclusion, statistical significance or population-level inference is made.
